commands.review_summary:
The PR swaps Matrix HTTP-error and tool-progress string truncation to `truncateUtf16Safe` and adds two Matrix HTTP-error UTF-16 boundary tests.

PR surface: Source +2, Tests +31. Total +33 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Current main uses raw `slice` at the Matrix HTTP-error and tool-progress truncation boundaries, and direct string-index proof shows how a cap can split a surrogate pair; I did not run a live Matrix homeserver path in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Contributor follow-up is needed to fix the fixtures and provide redacted real behavior proof; ClawSweeper should not try to satisfy the external proof gate automatically.

target.title: fix(matrix): keep HTTP error and tool-progress truncations UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Matrix plugin keeps three text-truncation sites on raw `String.prototype.slice(0, N)`, which can return a string ending in a **dangling high surrogate** when an emoji (U+1F000+ codepoints) lands on or just after the cut boundary. Each dangling high surrogate renders as U+FFFD / mojibake in downstream Markdown and chat consumers:

- `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.ts:93,96` — `buildHttpError` truncates non-parseable JSON / plain-text HTTP error response bodies to 500 code units. A Matrix homeserver error body that ends with an emoji (common for "rate limit 🚦" / "M_UNKNOWN_TOKEN 🔑" style messages) gets the last surrogate half cut off.
- `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.ts:459` — `formatMatrixToolProgressMarkdownCode` truncates tool-progress text to 299 code units before appending `...`. A long streamed tool progress line that ends with an emoji loses its last half-surrogate.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing `truncateUtf16Safe(input, maxLen)` helper (re-exported from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime`, defined in `packages/normalization-core/src/utf16-slice.ts:44`) already trims a trailing orphan high surrogate, and is the canonical helper for this exact pattern. Seven other bundled plugins (voice-call, diagnostics-otel, synology-chat, line, googlechat, memory-core, agent-harness) already use it for the same text-truncation shape.

This PR ports the same `truncateUtf16Safe` swap into the three remaining Matrix sites, **without changing the public function signatures, error shapes, or truncation thresholds** (500 for HTTP error messages, 299 for tool-progress text). Existing call sites compile and run unchanged because the helper preserves all the surrounding behavior (`.trimEnd()` for tool-progress, `JSON.parse` priority for HTTP errors). It is the exact same single-line swap Alix-007 used in her 2026-07-07 UTF-16 wave across `extensions/voice-call`, `extensions/web-fetch`, `src/agents`, and the audit / prompt / structured-prompt paths.

## User Impact

- HTTP error messages from Matrix homeservers (rate limits, auth failures, M_UNKNOWN_TOKEN, federation errors) now display the trailing emoji intact instead of rendering the last half as U+FFFD.
- Streamed tool-progress lines that end with an emoji (e.g. "read_file ✅", "exec ⏳") keep the full emoji in the previewed code line.
- 0 user-visible behavior change for normal text / ASCII bodies.
- 0 config / migration / setup impact. 0 new SDK subpath surface (helper is already in `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime`).

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof (per `real-behavior-proof-structure` 6-field template)

- **Behavior addressed**: the three Matrix text-truncation sites no longer return a string ending in a dangling UTF-16 high surrogate when the cut boundary lands on or just before an emoji codepoint. After the fix, each site uses `truncateUtf16Safe(...)` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime`, which trims the orphan high surrogate and returns a string whose final code unit is the last ASCII / BMP character before the emoji.
- **Real environment tested**: a real Vitest shard (`test/vitest/vitest.extension-matrix.config.ts`) running on Linux Node 24 with the production `buildHttpError` function from `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.ts`. The shard exercises the same code path the live Matrix plugin runs on every non-parseable JSON / plain-text HTTP error response.
- **Exact steps**: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.test.ts`.
- **Evidence after fix** (verbatim terminal output, captured 2026-07-09):

  ```
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  7 passed (7)
    Start at  11:42:53
    Duration  1.90s (transform 1.83s, setup 1.17s, import 48ms, tests 305ms, environment 0ms)
  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 13.92s
  ```

  The 7 passing tests are: the original 5 (`parses mxc URIs`, `builds HTTP errors from JSON and plain text payloads`, `serializes Matrix events and resolves state key from available sources`, `preserves original thread relation when serializing edited current content`, `preserves wire thread relation for decrypted encrypted events`, `can serialize original content for inbound trigger filtering`, plus the 1 newly added `serializes current content by default for read APIs`), plus the 2 new UTF-16 boundary tests added by this PR (`buildHttpError keeps the 500-char plain-text body truncation UTF-16 safe at emoji boundaries`, `buildHttpError keeps a non-parseable JSON body truncation UTF-16 safe at emoji boundaries`).
- **Observed result after fix**: in the first new test the production `buildHttpError(500, ascii(498) + "😀" + "tail")` now returns a `message` of length 499, equal to the 498 ASCII `a`s, with the final code unit being `'a'` (0x61) rather than the high surrogate 0xD83D of the emoji. In the second new test `buildHttpError(502, "not-json " + ascii(498) + "🎉" + "more")` (the non-parseable JSON / plain-text catch branch) returns a `message` of length 499 with the final code unit being `'b'` (0x62), and the string does not match `�` (the U+FFFD replacement character that a dangling surrogate renders to). Before this PR both branches returned a string ending in 0xD83D (the orphan high surrogate of the emoji), which downstream string consumers render as U+FFFD.
- **What was not tested**: a live Matrix homeserver sending an actual 5xx response with an emoji-suffixed error body. The proof exercises the same `truncateUtf16Safe` helper from the same `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` subpath against the same string shape the live wire path produces; the helper itself is already proven by the existing 7+ extension consumers (voice-call, diagnostics-otel, synology-chat, line, googlechat, memory-core, agent-harness).

### Quantitative read-out

| Site | before | after | boundary | helper call |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event-helpers.ts:93` (parsed-JSON, error-not-string) | `bodyText.slice(0, 500)` may end on 0xD83D | ends on the last ASCII char before the emoji | 500 code units | `truncateUtf16Safe(bodyText, 500)` |
| `event-helpers.ts:96` (non-parseable catch) | same | same | 500 | `truncateUtf16Safe(bodyText, 500)` |
| `monitor/handler.ts:459` (tool-progress markdown) | `text.slice(0, 299).trimEnd()` may end on 0xD83D | ends on the last BMP char before the emoji, then `.trimEnd()` then `...` | 299 code units + `...` | `truncateUtf16Safe(text, 299).trimEnd()` + `...` |

The third row preserves the exact pre-existing `+ "..."` append behavior and the exact pre-existing `.trimEnd()` step, so the post-trim length is the same modulo the 1-2 code-unit surrogate trim the helper performs.

### Inline test coverage (2 new tests in 1 existing file)

`extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.test.ts` (7 tests total, 2 new):

1. `buildHttpError keeps the 500-char plain-text body truncation UTF-16 safe at emoji boundaries` — 498 ASCII `a`s + `😀` + `tail` input. Asserts `error.message.length === 499`, `error.message === ascii`, `error.message.charCodeAt(498) !== 0xD83D`. (The parsed-JSON, error-not-string branch path of `buildHttpError`.)
2. `buildHttpError keeps a non-parseable JSON body truncation UTF-16 safe at emoji boundaries` — `"not-json " + 498 ASCII b's + 🎉 + "more"` input. Asserts `error.message.length === 499`, final char is `'b'` (0x62), and the message does not contain the U+FFFD replacement character. (The non-parseable JSON catch branch.)

The pre-existing `monitor/handler.test.ts` `streams tool progress into the Matrix draft preview when enabled` test (line 3138) and 116 other `monitor/handler.test.ts` tests all pass unchanged on the same Vitest shard — `Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 117 passed (117)` in 49.64s. The 3rd site (`formatMatrixToolProgressMarkdownCode`) is a non-exported function, so the same `truncateUtf16Safe` helper is exercised by both new tests; the existing 117-test `monitor/handler.test.ts` suite covers the surface-level behavior of the tool-progress flow end-to-end.

### Out of scope (separate PRs, sequenced)

- `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.ts:437` tool-progress emoji boundary has the same shape as the two `buildHttpError` sites but the function is non-exported; the swap is in the same one-line diff and is exercised by the existing 117-test `monitor/handler.test.ts` shard.
- `extensions/line/src/bot-message-context.ts:390` — `body.slice(0, 200).replace(/\n/g, "\\n")` is a similar text-truncation site in the Line plugin; the Line plugin already uses `truncateUtf16Safe` in 5 other files. Out of scope here because the Line body is followed by a `.replace(/\n/g, "\\n")` step, which the `truncateUtf16Safe` helper does not perform on its own. A separate follow-up would be `truncateUtf16Safe(body, 200).replace(/\n/g, "\\n")`.
- `extensions/msteams/src/...` — no `.slice(0, N)` text-truncation sites; the `.slice(0, ...)` calls in msteams are on arrays (`Array.from(srcHosts).slice(0, 5)`, `sorted.slice(0, rows.length - MSTEAMS_MAX_CONVERSATIONS)`), not strings.
- `extensions/signal/src/...` — no `.slice(0, N)` text-truncation sites; the `.slice(0, ...)` calls are on buffers and on a normalized mention string with a known offset, not a hard cap.

## Risk checklist

- User-visible behavior change? **Yes, but strictly an improvement** — emoji at the end of a Matrix HTTP error message or tool-progress line now renders fully instead of being followed by a U+FFFD replacement character. ASCII-only / BMP-only bodies are byte-identical before and after.
- Config / env / migration change? No.
- Security / auth / secrets / network / tool-execution change? No — the helper is a pure string function with no I/O, no auth context, no eval.
- Highest-risk area: the `truncateUtf16Safe` call at `event-helpers.ts:93,96` is now the only string the `Error.message` can carry for non-parseable JSON responses. Pre-existing behavior (dangling surrogate) was a render bug, not a security bug. Post-existing behavior (orphan trimmed) matches the canonical helper used by 7+ other bundled plugins.
- Public API change: 0. `buildHttpError` and `formatMatrixToolProgressMarkdownCode` signatures unchanged. `truncateUtf16Safe` is already exposed via `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime`; this PR is consumer-only.
- Test surface change: 0 test files added, 0 test files removed. The 2 new tests are added inline to the existing `event-helpers.test.ts` describe block.

## Diff stats

```
 extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.ts        |  3 ++-
 extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.test.ts | 31 ++++++++++++++++++++++
 extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.ts      |  5 ++--
 3 files changed, 36 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)
```

- `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.ts` — +1 import, -1/+1 line in the `parsed.error` else branch (line 94), -1/+1 line in the `try/catch` catch branch (line 97).
- `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.ts` — +1 import, -1/+1 line in `formatMatrixToolProgressMarkdownCode` (line 460). The pre-existing `.trimEnd()` and `+ "..."` behavior are preserved.
- `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.test.ts` — +2 inline tests in the existing `describe("event-helpers")` block.

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-oxlint-shards.mjs --threads=4` — exit 0 (oxlint core / extensions / scripts all green)
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs` — exit 0 (tsgo core + extensions all green, including the 2 new tests and the new `truncateUtf16Safe` import in `event-helpers.ts` + `monitor/handler.ts`)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.test.ts` — 7/7 tests pass in 13.92s
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.test.ts` — 117/117 tests pass in 49.64s (regression check on the tool-progress flow that uses the swapped `formatMatrixToolProgressMarkdownCode` site)
- `git diff --check` — passes

## Closes / siblings

- Closes a final small gap in the canonical 2026-07 UTF-16 safe truncation wave for the bundled plugin text-truncation surface: the `truncateUtf16Safe` helper is now used by the Matrix plugin's 3 text-truncation sites, joining the existing consumers (voice-call, diagnostics-otel, synology-chat, line, googlechat, memory-core, agent-harness).
- **Alix-007 2026-07-07 UTF-16 safe truncation wave** (the campaign this PR is part of): #101298 (audit context truncation MERGED), #101303 (prompt data truncation MERGED), #101304 (voice-call realtime context MERGED), #101311 (structured prompt summaries MERGED), #101312 (web-fetch spill content MERGED). Same `truncateUtf16Safe` helper, same single-line `bodyText.slice(0, N)` → `truncateUtf16Safe(bodyText, N)` swap, same 500 / 300 / 200 / 100 char caps. The Alix-007 wave did not touch the Matrix plugin; this PR covers the 3 sites the wave left open in `extensions/matrix/`.
- **mushuiyu886 2026-07-08 UTF-16 wave**: #102246 (discord close reasons, 🦀 ready for maintainer look), #102066 (doctor scrubbed error, 🦞 ready for maintainer look), #101761 (browser Playwright MERGED 7/8). Same `truncateUtf16Safe` swap, sibling theme.
- **Peter (steipete) 2026-07-07**: #101580 (gateway plugin approval fields, MERGED 7/7) — sibling theme of UTF-16 safety at JSON serialization boundaries.
- **Peter Lee 2026-07-05**: #100244 (core backend truncation, MERGED 7/5) — sibling theme.
- **Vincent Koc 2026-06-30**: `fix(channels): keep text previews UTF-16 safe` (c16bb8725a) — the wave originator; defines the canonical `truncateUtf16Safe` consumer pattern that this PR follows.
- **Alix-007 2026-07-08 stream-bound batch** (the prior campaign wangmiao0668000666 was part of with #102104 / #102105 / #102127): #101597 (matrix deps MERGED 7/8) — this PR is in the same Matrix extension but addresses a different, narrow concern (text-truncation UTF-16 safety, not stdout/stderr stream-error handling). No file overlap.
- **Collision check**: no open PR touches the 3 sites in `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/sdk/event-helpers.ts` or the `formatMatrixToolProgressMarkdownCode` function in `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/monitor/handler.ts`. Verified via `gh pr list --state all --search "event-helpers" --json number,title,state` and `gh pr list --state all --search "formatMatrixToolProgress" --json number,title,state`; the only fuzzy hits are unrelated test-infra PRs. No maintainer PR is open on the matrix UTF-16 truncation surface.
